verdict.rationale: LiveKit's first-party telephony docs cover inbound PSTN calls connected directly into rooms, with dispatch rules placing callers in the same or different rooms. They also cover programmatic outbound calls and region-restrictable trunks, so both dial-in and dial-out are documented. Missing for 10: explicit SIP protocol and trunk-setup detail in the quoted evidence, and independent or hands-on corroboration of telephony bridging.

support.subject: As a developer, phone callers join a session through documented SIP or PSTN dial-in and dial-out

citations.quote: LiveKit Phone Numbers lets you provision phone numbers and connect PSTN calls directly into LiveKit rooms without setting up trunks.
All callers can be placed in the same room or different rooms based on the dispatch rules.
Outbound calls enable your applications to initiate phone calls programmatically.
LiveKit telephony lets you build AI-powered voice apps that handle inbound and outbound calls.
Trunks can be region restricted to meet local telephony regulations.
